summary: BR Brain · Clean Link first phase

changes.title: Open cleaned links in Chrome
changes.detail: Eligible fresh clipboard links offer an explicit Chrome action within ten seconds; original clipboard remains unchanged.

changes.title: Conservative tracking removal
changes.detail: Known tracking identifiers are removed only on Chrome tap; unknown functional parameters are retained and sensitive URLs are refused.

changes.title: Safety and tests
changes.detail: Live receipt and editor checks, strict timestamps, monotonic deadline and pure URL policy tests. No network permission or signing changes.
